mentions.name: ssa.tools
mentions.description: This site helps people figure out their social security benefits for retirement planning. It includes a strategy feature that shows the tradeoffs of choosing different filing dates, with interactive sliders optimized for instant response times. The site is fully static so users' personal financial data never reaches the server.
mentions.audience: People planning for retirement who want to understand their social security benefits
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on and off for many years on https://ssa.tools/ - a site that helps folks figure out their social security benefits for retirement planning. I recently added and continue to iterate on a new feature for specifically helping you understand the tradeoffs of choosing different filing dates at https://ssa.tools/strategy
